BARD-WORN_LUTE.title: Worn Lute
BARD-WORN_LUTE.description: Your first [gold]Song[/gold] each combat starts with [blue]3[/blue] extra Verses.
BARD-WORN_LUTE.flavor: Three strings, one crack, a thousand taverns.
BARD-MASTER_LUTE.title: Master Lute
BARD-MASTER_LUTE.description: Your first [gold]Song[/gold] each combat starts with [blue]6[/blue] extra Verses.
BARD-MASTER_LUTE.flavor: Restrung with silver, and it remembers every tune.
BARD-SHEET_MUSIC.title: Sheet Music
BARD-SHEET_MUSIC.flavor: Dog-eared, wine-stained, annotated in three hands.
BARD-TUNING_FORK.title: Tuning Fork
BARD-TUNING_FORK.flavor: It hums a note nobody else can hear.
BARD-GOLDEN_STRINGS.title: Golden Strings
BARD-GOLDEN_STRINGS.description: While your [gold]Song[/gold] has [blue]10[/blue] or more Verses, its [gold]Refrain[/gold] triggers an extra time.
BARD-GOLDEN_STRINGS.flavor: They only sing once the room is listening.
BARD-BUSKERS_HAT.title: Busker's Hat
BARD-BUSKERS_HAT.flavor: Battered, upturned, and never quite empty.
